project.title: TrailCam CF10 low-profile FPV rover functional redesign

coordinate_frame.origin: vehicle longitudinal center plane at the lowest payload mounting datum
coordinate_frame.transform_convention: row-major 4x4 matrix maps component source coordinates to project millimetres

requirements.statement: The rover shall provide a forward analog-FPV view through a guarded RunCam Phoenix 2 SE V2-class camera and a separately mounted SpeedyBee TX800-class VTX.
requirements.verification: measured COTS envelopes, field-of-view collision test, power/thermal bench test and supervised video-under-load test

requirements.statement: Control shall use the EdgeTX/ExpressLRS 2.4 GHz LBT family through a rover-specific PWM receiver, independent of the analog video link.
requirements.verification: wiring review, failsafe test with total video loss, stall/brownout test and controlled range test

requirements.statement: Primary vehicle and payload loads shall pass through designed printed frame datums and printed nodes; bodyposts may locate only a light cover.
requirements.verification: datum inspection, load-path section review, static/impact/fatigue coupon qualification and proof-load test

requirements.statement: The traction battery shall remain in the lowest designed printed-tray position and the upper electronics bridge shall be open, ribbed and serviceable.
requirements.verification: assembly proxy, center-of-mass comparison and service-access review

requirements.statement: No payload component, cable or fastener may enter steering, suspension, wheel, driveshaft, motor, battery-access, disconnect, camera-view or RF-active keep-outs.
requirements.verification: exact CAD collision and swept-volume checks plus full-travel physical inspection

requirements.statement: Printed functional components shall be deterministic CadQuery B-Rep solids with STEP, watertight STL and 3MF handoff outputs after concept and decomposition approval.
requirements.verification: source regeneration, solid audit, mesh validation and exact slicer preflight

global_style.summary: low-profile technical crawler payload with dark printed frame structure and orange replaceable protection/service accents
global_style.generation_material: matte black and charcoal functional polymers with restrained orange service accents
global_style.detail_hierarchy: designed frame datums first, camera and RF protection second, low technical silhouette third

assembly_sequence: Print CHASSIS_PRINTED and qualify frame, arm and link coupons per AC-STRUCT-001 before vehicle assembly.
Assemble SUSPENSION_ARMS and AXLE_CARRIERS to the chassis pivot bosses with HARDWARE_KIT pivot pins and verify full suspension travel.
Install DRIVETRAIN_COTS and SERVO_COTS in their printed mounts, connect STEERING_LINKS and verify full steering travel against KEEP-STEERING.
Mount WHEELS_COTS and SHOCK_SET and verify the motion envelopes against KEEP-MOTION.
Fasten ELECTRONICS_BRIDGE to the chassis bridge mounts and verify load path, tool access and printed battery-tray removal.
Install CAMERA_COTS in CAMERA_GUARD, then install the guarded module at the front bridge interface.
Install RX_COTS and VTX_COTS in their separated RF_MOUNT_SET bodies with cable strain relief and antenna keep-outs.
Complete electrical, failsafe, thermal, RF, load and low-speed driving checks with human physical approval before FPV operation.

decision_log.topic: Approve concept revision 0.4.0-r2 and this functional decomposition before production CAD.
decision_log.current_basis: Concept 0.4.0-r2 approved by Stefan on 2026-08-29; the 0.3.0-r3 approval is invalidated by the chassis-route change recorded in design-spec.yaml revision 0.4.0.
decision_log.evidence_needed: None; approval recorded in design-spec.yaml revision 0.4.0 workflow.concept_approval.

decision_log.topic: Freeze the designed frame datums (wheelbase, track, ground clearance) from the 1:10 class reference, with Tamiya CC-02 as geometry reference only.
decision_log.current_basis: User decision 2026-08-29 removes any COTS/donor chassis; the fully printed chassis takes over frame, suspension and steering, but class-reference values are not yet sourced.
decision_log.evidence_needed: Sourced 1:10 class-reference values and a frozen parameter table before production CAD.

decision_log.topic: Select the axle/differential approach: purchased gearbox/diff unit preferred; printed low-speed gears/axles only with explicit strain justification and bench tests.
decision_log.current_basis: User decision 2026-08-30: two purchased geared motors, one per axle; no differential/transfer case; printed rigid axle housings/carriers. Printed gears/axles remain prohibited without strain justification and bench tests.
decision_log.evidence_needed: Named geared motor model with measured mounting envelope before manufacturing.

decision_log.topic: Freeze the exact drivetrain set (motor class, ratio, servo size) and wheel/tire size for the printed chassis.
decision_log.current_basis: Architecture frozen 2026-08-30: two 540/550-class planetary geared motors (one per axle), steering via servo plus printed links; exact motor model/ratio, ESC count and wheel/tire purchase remain open.
decision_log.evidence_needed: Named motor/ratio, ESC count, servo size and wheel/tire selection with measured envelopes.

decision_log.topic: Freeze measured camera, VTX, receiver, antenna, connector, cable and fastener envelopes.
decision_log.current_basis: RunCam Phoenix 2 SE V2, SpeedyBee TX800 and RadioMaster ER5C are platform-family candidates, not measured CAD authorities.
decision_log.evidence_needed: Exact purchased revisions, supplier drawings, calibrated samples, connector exits, bend radii and antenna active-element boundaries.

decision_log.topic: Approve payload mass, proof load and impact severity.
decision_log.current_basis: Planning values are 500 g service payload, 1000 g static proof load and supervised operation at or below 5 km/h.
decision_log.evidence_needed: Weighed electronics assembly, approved test fixture and test acceptance confirmation.

decision_log.topic: Freeze printer, PETG product, material condition, orientation and Anycubic process profile.
decision_log.current_basis: Kobra 3 Max, 0.6 mm nozzle, 0.66 mm line width and 0.24 mm layers are planning assumptions.
decision_log.evidence_needed: Complete exact machine/process/filament JSON profiles and process-matched coupon results.

decision_log.topic: Select RadioMaster MT12 ELRS or protocol-family-compatible Pocket transmitter ergonomics.
decision_log.current_basis: MT12 is recommended for surface controls; Pocket preserves more operator familiarity with OpenQuad.
decision_log.evidence_needed: Operator choice plus bound-receiver, channel-map and failsafe evidence.
